purpose: Advance reserve-now into one exact sealed passive-shell candidate without accepting construction, materials, future states, ownership, interfaces, operations, or fit-out.

phase0.role: 114 generated starts and immutable survey identity

d02.role: complete-save, geotechnical, structural, hydraulic, and ownership HOLDs

ownerReview.role: accepted planning policy with technical HOLDs retained

immutablePhase0PostRegionSnapshot.algorithm: sha256(filename + NUL + bytes + NUL, sorted by filename)

exactReferenceLine.relationshipToB11: same X/Z raster and rise stations; every Y is exact B11 roadY minus 6
exactReferenceLine.integerLatticeConvention: reference occupies the lower-Z and lower-Y central lattice column of both even sections

exactSection.orientationConvention: station slices are X-constant and offsets are global Z/Y; B11 advances +X with Z unchanged or -1

evenWidthSideBias.bias: one additional cell on positive-Z side

evenHeightSideBias.bias: one additional cell on positive-Y side

roadLoadSeparation.relationship: exact reservation between candidate roof and B11 road datum; not accepted structural cover

outerEnvelope.reconstructionRule: for each exact reference station: Z offsets -3…+4 and Y offsets -2…+3

innerEnvelopeBeforeClosures.reconstructionRule: for each exact reference station: Z offsets -2…+3 and Y offsets -1…+2

allSealedClosures.reconstructionRule: west cap union east cap union periodic bulkheads

proposedMaterialGeometry.reconstructionRule: lining boundary union sealed closures; no block state or material accepted

twoLayerRoadLoadSeparation.reconstructionRule: for each reference station: outer Z offsets and reference Y offsets +4,+5

candidateInfluenceUnion.reconstructionRule: outer envelope union two-layer road-load separation

maintenanceWalkway.reconstructionRule: non-closure stations at reference Z offsets -1…+2,Y-1

clearInspectionEnvelope.reconstructionRule: non-closure stations at reference Z offsets -1…+2,Y offsets 0…+2

unprogrammedInternalVoid.reconstructionRule: retained internal void minus programmed reservations

sealedUtilityEndpointCaps.reconstructionRule: dry, wet, and drainage reservation points at stations 0 and 298; contained by end caps

exactCurrentStateCensus.qualification: Exact current blocks and fluids in the copied region only; not excavation, replacement, groundwater, structural, hydraulic, or future-state evidence.

retainedHolds.basis: The bound snapshot contains region only; a same-moment entities/POI/level.dat save and exact entity clearance are absent.
No accepted excavation stability, void, lining, foundation, retaining, loading, settlement, waterproofing, or independent structural design exists.
Current fluid census is exact, but inflow, storage, freeboard, pump/passive outfall, power, receiver, failure, recovery, and future-fluid accounting are absent.
Dry/wet cells are geometric reservations only; no service, capacity, source, separation criterion, crossing, or commissioning is accepted.
The candidate is passive and nonoccupiable; egress, accessibility, ventilation/smoke, fire/service, lighting/power, barriers, drainage, and commissioning remain unresolved.
Separate candidate owners and five exact interface records are proposals only; the Z03/Z05 overlap has no canonical owner adjudication.
No complete default-deny global one-to-one interface audit has evaluated accepted candidate cell sets and contracts.
No future-state compiler, operation/material plan, source guards, rollback, preflight, atomic ledger, or release authorization exists.

decision.ifAnyHoldRemainsAtRoadRelease: Do not build the shell; retain the no-foreclosure reservation and sealed/null interfaces.

limitations: Exact candidate geometry is not an accepted future-state or construction manifest.
No Minecraft material or block state is selected; proposed material geometry is a functional quantity only.
Generated-start bounds and protected cores are exact default-deny comparisons but do not supply positive construction-influence margins.
Region-only current-state evidence omits entities, POI, level.dat, live occupancy, groundwater models, and future interactions.
The Houston overlap registry identifies every candidate interaction coordinate but accepts neither ownership nor a physical connection.
The passive shell has no authorized occupiable use, access, utility service, drainage discharge, operation, or release.
